BiblicalUsage: bebaiosis carries the plain sense of confirmation, and it shows up twice, in Philippians 1:7 and Hebrews 6:16.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that bebaiosis is a small window into a bigger truth, and I am glad it is there.
